items.q: How does the booking process work?
items.a:
Booking is simple.

  1. Choose your camper and travel dates
  2. We send you a personalized quote
  3. Confirm with a 50% deposit

The remaining balance is paid before pickup.

items.q: Do you offer discounts for long-term rentals?
items.a:
Yes.

We offer reduced rates for trips of 15 days or longer — Patagonia is best experienced slowly, and longer road trips usually get better pricing.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a:
• International bank transfer
  • Credit card

Credit card payments include a 3% processing fee.

items.q: Do I need a security deposit?
items.a:
Yes.

On the day of delivery, an amount of $1,500,000 CLP must be paid, which can be charged to a credit card, transferred, paid via PayPal, or in cash. The refund, provided the camper and truck are returned in the same condition as received, will be processed within 48 hours once the RV is returned (with a full diesel and gas tank). For rentals that include travel through Argentine territory, the security deposit increases to $2,000,000 CLP.

items.q: Can I cancel my trip?
items.a: Yes, but please consider: if you cancel your reservation before 30 days from the travel start date, 75% of the paid amount will be refunded. If you cancel after those 30 days, no refund will be issued.

items.q: Where can I pick up the camper?
items.a:
Our main base is in Puerto Varas, Chile.

We also offer pickup or drop-off options for an extra fee in:

  • Puerto Montt Airport
  • Coyhaique (Balmaceda Airport)
  • Puerto Natales

Other locations may be available on request. See exact fees on our Rental Hubs page.

items.q: What are the pickup and drop-off times?
items.a:
• Pickup: 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
  • Drop-off: before 4:00 PM

Every pickup includes a full walkthrough of the camper and its systems. For drop-off, please note that after 4:30 PM an additional day's rental will be charged.

items.q: Do I need a special license?
items.a:
You only need a valid driver's license from your country.

  • Minimum age: 25 years old
  • Manual transmission experience required

Additional drivers must meet the same requirements (25+, manual experience) and must be declared to South Nomads Campers before the rental begins. This is very important, because undeclared drivers are not covered by insurance.

items.q: Can I safely drive the Carretera Austral?
items.a:
Yes.

Our 4x4 camper trucks are built for Patagonia roads, gravel sections, and remote travel across southern Chile.

Drive slowly, enjoy the scenery, and you'll be fine.

items.q: Is there a mileage limit?
items.a: No — mileage is unlimited, with no daily or trip cap. Drive as much of the Carretera Austral as you like.

items.q: If I'm crossing into Argentina, does the permit cover multiple crossings?
items.a:
Yes — the permit and documentation we prepare cover crossing in and out of Argentina multiple times during your route.

Just let us know the date range during which you'll be crossing so we can prepare the paperwork correctly.

items.q: What is included inside the camper?
items.a:
Every camper includes the essentials for a Patagonia roadtrip:

  • Diesel heater
  • Kitchen kit
  • Fridge
  • Solar setup
  • Bedding
  • Outdoor table and chairs

See the full spec sheet on each camper's page: Nomads L · Nomads M.

items.q: Does the camper have a heater?
items.a: Yes — every camper comes with an off-grid diesel heater, independent from the vehicle's fuel system. It's very effective for cold Patagonian nights.

items.q: What about solar power and batteries?
items.a: Each camper has a solar panel, auxiliary battery, and 220V inverter — enough to keep you comfortably off-grid for several days.

items.q: Is there hot water or a shower?
items.a: Not included as standard, but we offer a portable shower with its own gas-powered water heater (12V, 18,000 BTU) as an add-on for an extra fee — just let us know when booking and we'll have it ready for your trip.

items.q: What's the fridge like?
items.a: An Alpicool 22L compressor fridge — a proper compressor unit (not a thermoelectric cooler), so it holds temperature reliably even on warm days.

items.q: What's included in the kitchen?
items.a: Every camper comes fully equipped: a full cookware and dinnerware set (pots, pans, plates, cutlery), a stainless steel sink, a fresh water tank, and a portable gas stove.

items.q: Are bedding, pillows, and towels included?
items.a: Bedding and linens are included, along with a premium down duvet. Towels are not included — we recommend packing microfibre travel towels if you're tight on space; they're easy to find at Decathlon, including a branch in the Puerto Montt mall.

items.q: What about tires?
items.a: 4-season all-terrain tires, plus a spare tire and jump cables — ready for gravel and the Carretera Austral.

items.q: Do you have a BBQ or grill?
items.a: Not included as standard equipment, but we're happy to add one for an extra fee — just let us know when booking.

items.q: Does the camper have an awning?
items.a: No, the camper doesn't include an awning.

items.q: Do the campers have internet?
items.a:
We offer optional Starlink satellite internet rentals.

Perfect for remote work or staying connected during your Patagonia roadtrip.

items.q: How does insurance work?
items.a:
Insurance is already included in your rental — there's nothing extra to pay for it. It has two parts:

  • SOAP — mandatory Chilean coverage, which includes roadside assistance within Chile.
  • CDW (Collision Damage Waiver) — covers repairs to the vehicle if something happens to the camper.

The deductible is approximately €1,000 (≈ CLP 1,057,000), and third-party liability coverage is UF 1,000.

We always recommend travelers also get their own travel insurance, in case you need to cover medical expenses during the trip — we don't sell or arrange that ourselves, just a friendly heads up.

items.q: What does the insurance actually cover?
items.a:
It's comprehensive coverage, not just liability — so the camper is covered even in a single-vehicle accident with no other car involved. Specifically:

Covered:

  • Windshield and glass
  • Rollovers
  • Single-vehicle accidents
  • Underbody damage, as long as you're on a public road (gravel and dirt count — that's most of the Carretera Austral)

Not covered:

  • Tires and wheels on their own — a standalone flat or blowout isn't covered, only tire damage that happens as part of a bigger accident affecting the rest of the vehicle
  • Driving off designated roads (river crossings, sand, terrain not meant for vehicles)

One important distinction: this insurance covers the truck, not the camper body itself. That's what your security deposit is for — if the camper body is damaged, the deposit covers it instead of just the smaller deductible.

items.q: Is roadside assistance included?
items.a: Yes — roadside assistance is included (as part of the mandatory SOAP coverage) for the duration of your rental across continental Chile, including Chiloé.

items.q: Do I need to return the camper clean?
items.a:
Yes, please. We kindly ask that you follow this return checklist:

  1. Fuel tank: the camper is delivered with a full tank. It must be returned with a full tank — missing fuel is charged at CLP $2,500/liter.
  2. Interior & exterior: clean (fee: up to $150,000 CLP if not)
  3. Portable toilet: empty and clean (fee: up to $300,000 CLP if not)
  4. All equipment: complete and undamaged per the inventory list
  5. Vehicle documents: returned to South Nomads Campers

items.q: What happens if I need help during the trip?
items.a:
Our main goal is that you travel securely and enjoy our beautiful country to the fullest, so we're available throughout your trip!

You can contact us for:

  • Route recommendations
  • Weather advice
  • Mechanical support
  • General travel questions

We always recommend texting us on WhatsApp before emailing. Rodrigo or Josefina will assist you without delay.
